7444.title: ACP registry branding inventory omits four published agent IDs
7444.rootCauseOneLine: The static icon ID inventory omits four published registry IDs, causing null registry icons and Toolbox configured-provider fallback.
7444.proposedFix: Sync reviewed artwork and declarations for missing IDs, with deterministic registry coverage. No automatic PR: the current per-ID asset contract needs seven files, exceeding the five-file safety limit.
7444.caveats: Both production resolution paths reproduced in two clean Linux checkouts. Browser capture was blocked by missing Chrome; no Windows desktop or real-provider session was run. Test and fixture are inline because the reports repository prohibits committed repro files.
